sentence: 寒冬季节，河面都结冰了。
pinyin: Hándōng jìjié, hémiàn dōu jié bīng le.
english: In the depths of winter, the river surface has frozen over.

sentence: 乘务员提醒大家系好安全带。
pinyin: Chéngwùyuán tíxǐng dàjiā jì hǎo ānquándài.
english: The flight attendant reminded everyone to fasten their seatbelts.

sentence: 政府很关心老百姓的衣食住行。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ hěn guānxīn lǎobǎixìng de yī shí zhù xíng.
english: The government cares a lot about ordinary people's basic living needs.

sentence: 他尝遍了生活中的酸甜苦辣。
pinyin: Tā chángbiàn le shēnghuó zhōng de suān tián kǔ là.
english: He has experienced all the ups and downs of life.

sentence: 我们这次旅行住在一家民宿里。

english: On this trip we stayed at a guesthouse.

sentence: 他生病请假了，老师帮他补课。
pinyin: Tā shēngbìng qǐngjià le, lǎoshī bāng tā bǔkè.
english: He was sick and took leave, so the teacher helped him make up the lesson.

sentence: 请在这里写下你的住址。
pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ xiě xià nǐ de zhùzhǐ.
english: Please write down your address here.

sentence: 她把包裹邮寄给了远方的朋友。
pinyin: Tā bǎ bāoguǒ yóujì gěi le yuǎnfāng de péngyou.
english: She mailed the package to a friend far away.

sentence: 这个孩子从小就很聪慧。
pinyin: Zhège háizi cóngxiǎo jiù hěn cōnghuì.
english: This child has been very intelligent since he was little.

sentence: 警察每天在街上巡逻。
pinyin: Jǐngchá měitiān zài jiē shàng xúnluó.
english: Police patrol the streets every day.

sentence: 医生检查了他的脊椎有没有受伤。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le tā de jǐzhuī yǒu méiyǒu shòushāng.
english: The doctor checked whether his spine was injured.

sentence: 你可以打电话去公司咨询价格。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dǎ diànhuà qù gōngsī zīxún jiàgé.
english: You can call the company to inquire about the price.

sentence: 她喜欢躺在床上浏览手机新闻。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan tǎng zài chuáng shàng liúlǎn shǒujī xīnwén.
english: She likes to lie in bed browsing news on her phone.

sentence: 老人用香油膏干裂的双手。
pinyin: Lǎorén yòng xiāngyóu gào gānliè de shuāngshǒu.
english: The old man applies sesame oil to moisten his chapped hands.

sentence: 听到这个结果，大家都很惊讶。

english: Hearing this result, everyone was astonished.

sentence: 员工每天上班都要打卡。
pinyin: Yuángōng měitiān shàngbān dōu yào dǎkǎ.
english: Employees have to clock in every day when they arrive at work.

sentence: 创业的过程十分艰难。

sentence: 我去邮局寄一封信。

english: I'm going to the post office to send a letter.

sentence: 早晚刷牙以后要漱口。
pinyin: Zǎowǎn shuāyá yǐhòu yào shùkǒu.
english: You should rinse your mouth after brushing your teeth morning and night.

sentence: 他唱歌唱得太多，嗓子哑了。
pinyin: Tā chànggē chàng de tài duō, sǎngzi yǎ le.
english: He sang too much and his throat became hoarse.

sentence: 这门课是大学生的必修课。
pinyin: Zhè mén kè shì dàxuéshēng de bìxiū kè.
english: This course is a required course for university students.

sentence: 以前结婚常常要靠媒人介绍。
pinyin: Yǐqián jiéhūn chángcháng yào kào méiren jièshào.
english: In the past, marriages often relied on matchmakers for introductions.

sentence: 他感冒了，一直咳嗽。
pinyin: Tā gǎnmào le, yīzhí késou.
english: He caught a cold and has been coughing constantly.
